EmailTemplate.subject: Are you taking on too much FX risk?
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {{lead.First Name:default=Friend}},
Going into 2023, finance and treasury teams for global organizations are assessing where to focus and what responsibilities can be consolidated, offloaded, or terminated. You might be thinking about areas like how to consolidate global bank accounts, how to build that source of truth for cash flow data, and how to offload FX risk.
Join us <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/worth-the-risk-online-webinar]]>on Tuesday, November 1st at 12pm CT/1pm ET for a webinar that will discuss:
- What is high-return, "good" risk your team should focus on - How to identify risk that isn't core to your business - Best practices for managing FX and receivables risk
Register today <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/worth-the-risk-online-webinar]]>
If you can’t make it, you can still register and I will make sure to send you the recording! Or you can let me know here. I hope to connect with you soon!
Thank you,
Flywire for B2B
